snippet.title: Dead or Alive New Project -  Teaser Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
The production of the newest "DEAD OR ALIVE" series title has started! 
 
DEAD OR ALIVE is a fighting action game series, first released in 1996. So, this year marks its 30th anniversary.
 
We look forward to your continued support of the DEAD OR ALIVE series.
 
#ps5 #ps5games #stateofplay #deadoralive
